description: Resume vs job-ad keyword check, the way applicant tracking systems screen: extracts the job ad's key terms (words and two-word phrases, weighted by frequency), shows which the resume already covers and which are missing, and gives a 0-100 coverage score and the top terms to add. Plain text analysis of the two texts you send; no AI rewriting and no data is stored. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

job.description: Job ad plain text, up to 4,000 characters (required)

resume.description: Resume / CV plain text, up to 6,000 characters (required; sent as a query parameter)

top.description: How many job terms to score, 10 to 60 (default 30)

name: jobs_cv_optimizer
title: Jobs Cv Optimizer
